title: A flock on the road
text: Sheep fill the road from verge to verge, and {a} and {b} are whistling them along toward the next pasture. "Mind the lambs," calls {a}.

choices.label: Help drive them through the gap

effects.text: Between you, the flock is through. {a} gives you a heel of cheese for it.

choices.label: Ask what's about on the road ahead
Stand aside and let them pass
